knowledge.title: ACT-7 electrical limits
knowledge.full: ACT-7 runs at 48 V. Rated 25 A continuous. Peak 40 A for up to 5 s. Stall current 55 A.

knowledge.title: ACT-7 thermal limits
knowledge.full: Winding limit is 120 °C. Thermal time constant is about 90 s. Allow at most 3 peak events per minute.
knowledge.releasable: Winding temperature limits apply; details are internal.

knowledge.title: Controller current limit
knowledge.full: Set the controller's peak current limit to 38 A to keep margin below the 40 A rating.
knowledge.releasable: A recommended controller limit exists; details are internal.

knowledge.title: Bearing supplier and cost
knowledge.full: Bearings come from supplier HERON at $12.80 each, with a 6.2% reject rate. Ref ACT-3308.
knowledge.releasable: Bearings come from a qualified supplier; commercial terms are restricted.

knowledge.title: ACT-8 roadmap
knowledge.full: ACT-8 moves to a 96 V bus in 2027 and drops the gearbox. Ref ACT-9120.
knowledge.releasable: A next-generation actuator is planned; details are restricted.
